verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine that also ships on-device chat apps and an OpenAI-compatible server. Products of this kind can plausibly offer chat-with-your-documents or data-insight features, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers model serving, one-shot chat, adapters and expert offload, with nothing on ingesting a user's data or generating insights or suggestions from it inside the product.
